record.question: Which reviewed NPS trail features and explicit connectors complete the remaining western Yosemite and Tioga Road routes?
record.reason: May Lake and the Tioga Road approach to Lukens Lake now have reviewed named-feature graphs. Merced Grove intersects a longer named old-road feature, Tuolumne Grove requires an unresolved road-to-loop join, and the White Wolf, Harden Lake, North Dome, Ten Lakes, and Grand Canyon routes remain branched or incomplete; no nearby geometry is snapped into a route.
